description: This file defines a Kotlin source code module for managing and displaying tool configurations within an Android application. It includes data classes, serialization logic, and functions for resolving and presenting tool metadata, including labels, icons, and details based on configuration files and runtime context.

classes.name: ToolDisplayActionSpec
classes.description: Serializable data class representing an optional label and detail keys for tool actions.

classes.name: ToolDisplaySpec
classes.description: Serializable data class encapsulating display properties such as emoji, title, label, detail keys, and actions for tools.

classes.name: ToolDisplayConfig
classes.description: Serializable configuration class containing version, fallback, and tools map for display specifications.

classes.name: ToolDisplaySummary
classes.description: Data class representing a resolved summary of a tool, including name, emoji, title, label, verb, and detail strings.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Main function to resolve and generate a ToolDisplaySummary based on context, tool name, arguments, and meta information.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Loads and caches the configuration from a JSON asset file.

methods.name: titleFromName
methods.description: Generates a human-readable title from a tool's name string.

methods.name: normalizeVerb
methods.description: Normalizes action verb strings by cleaning underscores and whitespace.

methods.name: readDetail
methods.description: Constructs a detail string based on read action parameters.

methods.name: pathDetail
methods.description: Constructs a detail string based on a file path parameter.

methods.name: firstValue
methods.description: Retrieves the first non-empty rendered value from arguments for a list of keys.

methods.name: valueForPath
methods.description: Extracts a nested value from JSON arguments based on a dot-separated path.

methods.name: renderValue
methods.description: Converts a JSON element into a string preview, handling primitives and arrays.

methods.name: shortenHomeInString
methods.description: Replaces user home directory paths with '~' for cleaner display.

methods.name: asStringOrNull
methods.description: Extension to safely extract string from a JSON element.

methods.name: asNumberOrNull
methods.description: Extension to safely extract a numeric value from a JSON element.
